scientific_question: When paired with a separately frozen issue-time-causal SEP onset model, does the frozen V2 causal rolling threshold controller reduce false-positive rate to <=0.30 without materially degrading onset detection relative to the same model's frozen fixed threshold?

protected_pool.development_side_rule: Do not query, count, inspect, score, stratify, or use protected outcomes to rescue power or tune the controller/source model.

required_before_any_protected_scoring: source-model freeze timestamp earlier than outcome unseal
source_model_gate.reason: Phase II used historical GOES-15/XRS-era source adaptation and was development-only; prospective eligibility requires a separately verified causal source-model package rather than assuming transportability.

threshold_at_issue_t_may_use: negative outcomes from earlier issues only after the complete 24-hour horizon plus one-hour buffer has resolved
threshold_at_issue_t_may_not_use: development-side manual overrides informed by protected outcomes

evaluation.target: new >10 MeV proton crossing to >=10 pfu in (issue_time, issue_time+24h] when not already active at issue
evaluation.comparison: same frozen model probabilities under fixed-threshold policy versus frozen V2 controller policy

information_floor.note: Frozen before protected counts are inspected; this is a design floor, not a power guarantee.

bootstrap.pairing: shared resample of positive episode units and negative quiet-block units reused for fixed-threshold and controller policies

all_required: paired 95% interval for controller FPR minus fixed-threshold FPR strictly below 0
paired 95% interval for controller POD minus fixed-threshold POD has lower bound > -0.10
paired 95% interval for controller TSS minus fixed-threshold TSS has lower bound > 0
protected pool remained sealed from development side until conclusion freeze
confirmation_gates.interpretation_if_failed: Do not claim prospective controller improvement; report failure or insufficient information exactly as observed.

development_side_receives_before_conclus: execution readiness status without protected counts

claim_boundary.allowed_if_all_gates_pass: prospective evidence that the frozen adaptive threshold policy improves the operating point of the separately frozen source model under this protocol
not_allowed: state-of-the-art forecasting claim without same-cohort comparator reproduction
